mechanism_narrative: A continued recovery in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT lifts weekday footfall to nearby shops and eateries, pushing RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks as commuting-linked discretionary trips rebuild.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise above its last-4-weeks mean over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both increasing or staying flat.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL mobility falls from its current elevated level, more residents spend time away from home and more retail visits occur within one to two weeks, raising RETAIL_REC quickly.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL declines by at least 2 points week-on-week after being above 35 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL drops below its prior two-week average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES below their recent levels signals tighter movement constraints or reduced in-person activity, which suppresses retail visits and drives RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both fall for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior 4-week mean after both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below their previous week values for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility is persistently weak while RETAIL_REC is already low, outdoor leisure demand is not spilling into shopping districts, so retail activity stays depressed or drifts lower over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -60 for at least two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases in the next 7 days while PARKS stays below -60 for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM indicates more routine errand travel and neighborhood circulation, which spills over into adjacent retail trips and raises RETAIL_REC within two to four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-weeks mean over the next 28 days despite a sustained rise in GROCERY_PHARM.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES rises while RESIDENTIAL eases, the city is shifting from home-based to out-of-home activity, and RETAIL_REC will increase over the next four weeks because more people combine commutes with shopping.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days when WORKPLACES trends up and RESIDENTIAL trends down.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp improvement in TRANSIT after a prior trough signals restored access to city centers, and retail mobility follows with a one-week lag as shoppers and workers return to mixed-use areas.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 3 points week-on-week from a level below -68
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 7 days after TRANSIT rises sharply from a very low base.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM both soften at the same time, the city is losing weekend and errand-based circulation, and RETAIL_REC will decline over the next four weeks because leisure and necessity trips are both weakening.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days even though both PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM decline from their current levels.
